notes/Research/Starting Quest Chains.md: the starting-region rows use five-coin rewards. This event quest deliberately pays a larger prize, recorded as (R) in the adjacent tag.

lab/reports/locale-id-to-text.json: Global.Text id 3374 is the generic stock string 'Scavenger Hunt '. The Greenwood Forest minigame title 429342 ('The Great Scavenger Hunt', notes/Research/original-activity-coverage.json activity 1038) belongs to a different retail activity.

(R) T247/F272: the record keeps the generic stock Global.Text 3374 'Scavenger Hunt ' and deliberately does not reuse the Greenwood Forest minigame's 429342 title. The admin event is identified by its host and its three stops, not by a new title or locale line.

(R) T247/F272/T281: authored admin-event scavenger hunt at existing starting-road landmarks. Three VisitPosition stops at copied NPC-row positions and a return Talk to Jacque; no new NPC spawn, objective kind, reward path, packet or realm command. The host is a drawable Sanctuary NPC with no authored quest, so the first Talk starts the hunt without a referral step. The admin starts the event with a broadcast that names the host and the three stops.

(R) T281 host choice: Jacque 9500000497 is a drawable legacy_data NPC at Jacque's Cafe in Pixiewood Hills, the southern entrance street of Sanctuary (notes/Build Guides/Content/NPCs/NPCs - Sanctuary.md:15,51). At the parent tip he gave no quest: his row's quest_ids_given, quests_given and quests_accepted are empty, and no quest record named him giver_npc_id. The hunt is now his only giver record (tests/scavenger_hunt_quest.rs pins that). He is the host and the final Talk target. This choice deliberately avoids the rejected Ricky Danger design (Call The Crew 3000059 and Back for More 3000060 name Ricky as giver, so an explicit first-offer binding would put the custom event ahead of an original chain); the NPC row's explicit quest_ids_given order is consulted before QuestEngine::quest_ids_for_giver, so original quests keep priority.

(R) T247: the stop order (Pappy's farm, brawling ring, Highroad Junction, Jacque), the 8.0 m radius and the 50-coin / 25-Adventurer-XP reward are local event policy. Notes/Design/World Builder.md records the admin-hunt intent: the admin broadcasts hints and the quest is the objective.

(R) T247/F272: the split loader requires the quest catalogue to equal the union of every jobs.json quest_ids list (src/quest_engine.rs from_split_content), so the Adventurer job lists 3000200. This is a loader structural invariant, not a job gate: the record has no job field, is not Adventurer content, and the giver offer comes only from giver_npc_id through QuestEngine::quest_ids_for_giver. No NPC row was edited; tests/scavenger_hunt_quest.rs pins the loader rejection of a standalone quest.
